## `proxmox-lab console`

guest screenshots and keyboard input

- `proxmox-lab console keys` — send key names/combinations via qm sendkey
- `proxmox-lab console screenshot` — capture the guest screen as a PNG
- `proxmox-lab console type` — type text at the guest console (one key per character)

## `proxmox-lab doctor`

check config, ssh access and store


## `proxmox-lab gc`

host-side garbage collector: install, status, uninstall

- `proxmox-lab gc install` — copy the GC script to the host and ensure its crontab line
- `proxmox-lab gc status` — script presence, checksum and crontab line (read-only)
- `proxmox-lab gc uninstall` — remove the crontab line and the script

## `proxmox-lab guest`

guest lifecycle over the proxmox seam

- `proxmox-lab guest clone` — clone a registry-vouched template into a new guest
- `proxmox-lab guest create` — create a lease-owned guest from the template, or fresh
- `proxmox-lab guest destroy` — destroy a lease-owned guest (irreversible)
- `proxmox-lab guest list` — registered guests joined with live state (read-only)
- `proxmox-lab guest probe` — how can this guest be reached? (read-only)
- `proxmox-lab guest run` — run a command in a lease-owned guest
- `proxmox-lab guest start` — start a lease-owned guest
- `proxmox-lab guest stop` — stop a lease-owned guest (graceful, then hard)

## `proxmox-lab power`

host power: wake it, check it, or verify a shutdown

- `proxmox-lab power shutdown` — power the host off, verified by repeated probe failure (authorization required)
- `proxmox-lab power status` — whether the host is answering and what pins it on
- `proxmox-lab power wake` — wake without a lease (manual operations only; authorization required)
